title: 第11章 一个笑得刺眼，一个笑得灿烂-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    有人拼命忍着笑，有人像看白痴一样看她。

    刘超嫌丢人地将脸撇向了一边，一副没眼睛看的表情。

    而被“要钱”的当事人于清足足愣了好几秒，拍戏拍到今天没被现场要过钱。

    这小姑娘已经是第二次了。

    第一次当场问价格，第二次拍完了要加钱。

    还一副被影帝占了便宜的委屈巴巴的表情。

    正当他准备问“要一百还是二百”的时候，沈珩接了话。

    “抱歉，是我冒犯了！走吧，我补给你。”说罢，率先往一旁自己的休息区走去。

    没给韩小汐拒绝的机会。

    韩小汐只能说着“不用不用”追了上去。

    离开风暴中心。

    拍摄现场继续。

    于清也没催沈珩，优先拍田馨的戏份。

    大概是为了保护影帝隐私，沈珩的临时休息区在一间单独的花厅，避着风，还有两个小太阳取暖器。

    郭炜和斯蒂芬都窝在这里。

    看着自家老板后面跟着个眼熟的小姑娘，都惊掉了下巴。

    这两人怎么又“勾搭”上了？

    两人交换了一个意味不明的眼神，面上倒是规矩的起身打招呼。

    沈珩点头，没接郭炜递过来的水杯，反倒让两人出去。

    声音冷冷的，一点也不温和。

    这是韩小汐的感受。

    沈珩随意在一张折叠椅上坐下，看着韩小汐，带着审视。

    韩小汐被他看得心里发毛，浑身不自在。

    “你很缺钱？”终于，沈珩开了口，很直接。

    韩小汐被问得一愣。

    不过还是很诚实地点头。

    学历很重要，学费也是真的贵，但她不想辍学。

    沈珩又沉默了好半晌。

    韩小汐像个不敢说话的小学生站在老师面前一般。低着头，没穿外套，感觉有点冷。

    小太阳也带不来温暖。

    沈珩收回视线，随意从一边的架子上捞过自己的外套，掏出钱包，打开。

    韩小汐眨巴了一下桃花眼，这位不会真的要给她“补偿”吧？！

    果然——

    “你刚刚说加钱，”他顿了顿，“多少合适？”

    “沈老师，真的不用了，刚刚我就是随口一说。您当没听到！”韩小汐急忙摆手。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Some people tried their best to hold back their laughter, while others looked at her like an idiot.

Liu Chao turned his face to one side in embarrassment, with an expression of no eyes.

The person who was "asked for money", Yu Qing, was stunned for several seconds. During the filming, he has never been asked for money on the spot.

This is the second time for this little girl.

The first time I asked the price on the spot, the second time I had to pay more after the auction.

He also looked aggrieved that he had been taken advantage of by the actor.

Just when he was about to ask, "Would you like one hundred or two hundred?", Shen Heng answered.

"Sorry, I was offended! Let's go, I'll supply you." After saying that, he took the lead and walked to his rest area.

She didn’t give Han Xiaoxi a chance to refuse.

Han Xiaoxi could only say "No, no, no" and chased after him.

Leave the center of the storm.

The filming scene continues.

Yu Qing didn’t push Shen Heng and gave priority to filming Tian Xin’s scenes.

“Probably to protect the actor’s privacy, Shen Heng’s temporary rest area is in a separate flower hall, sheltered from the wind, and there are two small sun heaters.

Guo Wei and Stephen are both nesting here.

When I saw a familiar little girl following my boss, my jaw dropped.

Why did these two people "hook up" again?

The two of them exchanged glances with unclear meaning, but stood up to say hello in a polite manner.

Shen Heng nodded and did not take the water glass handed over by Guo Wei. Instead, he let the two of them go out.

The voice was cold, not gentle at all.

This is how Han Xiaoxi feels.

Shen Heng casually sat down on a folding chair and looked at Han Xiaoxi with scrutiny.

Han Xiaoxi felt frightened when he saw her and felt uncomfortable all over.

"Are you short of money?" Finally, Shen Heng spoke very directly.

Han Xiaoxi was stunned when asked.

But he nodded honestly.

Educational qualifications are very important, and tuition is really expensive, but she doesn’t want to drop out of school.

Shen Heng was silent for a long time.

Han Xiaoxi stood in front of the teacher like a primary school student who dared not speak.With my head down and no coat on, I felt a little cold.

Even the little sun cannot bring warmth.

Shen Heng withdrew his gaze, casually grabbed his coat from the shelf on one side, took out his wallet, and opened it.

Han Xiaoxi blinked her peach-blossom eyes. This person doesn’t really want to “compensate” her, right?!

Sure enough——

"You just said more money," he paused, "How much is appropriate?"

"Teacher Shen, it's really no need. I just said it casually. You pretend you didn't hear it!" Han Xiaoxi waved her hand hurriedly.
